ai_engineer.name: Jordan Chen
ai_engineer.title: Senior AI & Machine Learning Engineer
ai_engineer.summary: Specialized in LLM Agents, Multi-Agent Orchestration (LangGraph, AutoGen), RAG architectures with hybrid search, and production ML pipelines. 5+ years shipping enterprise AI solutions.

highlights: Architected an autonomous customer support multi-agent system handling 120,000 queries/day with 94% first-contact resolution.
Implemented hybrid RAG combining BM25 sparse search and text-embedding-3-large with Cohere cross-encoder reranking, reducing hallucination by 42%.
Engineered tool-calling safety sandboxes with dynamic schema validation and token budget guards.
Developed distributed feature store and low-latency inference endpoints serving 45ms P99 responses via Triton Inference Server.
Fine-tuned open-source Llama-2-13B models using PEFT/LoRA for domain-specific contract risk extraction.

ai_engineer.education: B.S. in Computer Science, UC Berkeley

highlights: Led modernization of enterprise analytics dashboard to React Server Components, decreasing initial bundle size by 65% and improving LCP from 3.2s to 0.9s.
Engineered distributed event ingestion pipeline processing 25,000 events/sec using Kafka and Go consumers writing to partitioned PostgreSQL shards.
Eliminated database deadlock cascades during flash sales by implementing Redis distributed locks and optimistic concurrency control.
Built real-time collaboration canvas using WebSockets and operation-based CRDTs, supporting up to 40 concurrent users per whiteboard.
